Name: Kakuzu -Shane replacement-
Author: VIRUSqueen
Description:
[center][b][size=3]﻿Hello! This is VIRUSqueen and I'm here to give you sprites of Akatsuki characters ♥[/size][/b]
[/center][center]
[img]https://s3.narvii.com/image/a6ig54sar2xeknolmszb44bal3dhecqg_128.jpg[/img]
Kakuzu, the self proclaimed Treasurer of Akatsuki

[/center]
I plan to edit all the bachelors and bachelorettes, and admittedly some other characters, into Akatsuki members, and the first ready is Kakuzu, replachig Shane. For all these mods, I want to heavily stress that all these characters [u]are replacements[/u], and not new characters added into the game. To note, the Kakuzu I have drawn is unmasked Kakuzu, so you get to see him in all his glory.

Also, I have not edited the dialogue or names of the characters what so ever. Only the 'cosmetics' have changed, and therefore I would love to get help in that sense, or I will in time edit the dialogue myself, thank you!


[b]How to Install[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Downlod the zip fie[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the file[/size]
[*][size=2]Place the files in the right folders, replacing the old ones[/size]
[*][size=2]The portrait into Contents>Portraits[/size]
[*][size=2]The sprites into Contents>Characters[/size]
[/list]
